relationships.evidence: Visual Table Understanding (VTU) generally encompasses four subtasks: Table Detection (TD), which locates tables within document images; Table Structure Recognition (TSR), which parses the structure of tables in table-centric images; Table Querying (TQ), which recognizes the structure of a table from an entire image at a given location, a task that remains underexplored in the previous works; and Table Question Answering (TQA), which answers questions based on table contents.
